title: SREV-066 low-level hotpatch scan window contract

remote_read.description: ReadProcessMemory byte transfer from target process memory

local_buffer.description: Local myBuffer capacity and byte-addressed scan offsets

pattern_window.description: ULONG_PTR-sized pattern window used to find hotpatch space

contracts: ReadProcessMemory copies nSize bytes into the caller-provided local buffer and reports bytes read
The hotpatch scanner may read an ULONG_PTR pattern only when scan_offset plus sizeof(ULONG_PTR) fits inside myBuffer
Scan offsets are byte offsets because the selected remote table address is byte-oriented
The scanner must not use short-element indexing to derive byte offsets
The fallback scan must fail closed when no full ULONG_PTR pattern window is found
Fallback comments must name SREV-066 instead of generic hack wording
